second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 12 + Average 4 + Difficulty 1 = 17), pdf 35; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-17 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-4, II 5-7, III 8-10, IV 11-13, V 14-17); answer side keys 1-17 in order (key 1 printed with a doubled label '1. 1.'). BLUE PRINT 12/4/1 = 17 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 17.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 35 (heading 'Unit -8', LO 4, BLUE PRINT, q1-4) 36 (q5-14) 37 (q15-17). A side 'Key Answers.:- 8. Let’s build a house' pdf 109 (keys 1-17). Folios = pdf page.
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode both sides; key 1's line carries legacy-Nudi junk after the English — cut off).

Sections: s1 I 'Name the materials …' q1-4 (each question prints only the house name and answer dashes -> text = section instruction + the printed line, dashes removed and kept in text_as_printed; list keys -> vsa); s2 II 'Arrange the uses' q5-7 (two printed columns, numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III 'Who am I?' q8-10 (riddle + answer dashes; one-word keys -> vsa); s4 IV q11-13 (one sentence/list -> vsa); s5 V fill q14-17.
MARKS (R-E9 as clarified at control rev 3: N = printed count -> M whatever its size): s1 '4 X 2=8' -> 2; s2 '3 X1=3' -> 1; s3 '3 X1=3' -> 1; s4 '3 X2=6' -> 2; s5 '4x1=4' -> 1. All section_header.
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 17 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 4, lo_source 'lesson_table'.
KEYS: verbatim incl. trailing punctuation ('To build a wall,', 'Roof.'); q10 key 'Tarasi' (the terrace house, transliterated) kept. No flags.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-08-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
